Chinese Payments Giant Alipay Denies Supporting Crypto Trading via Third-Party Platforms

Chinese payments giant Alipay stated that it does not support cryptocurrency trading or related services, adding that claims suggesting Alipay enables crypto purchases through third-party platforms are false and unauthorized. The statement came after P2P trading platform Peer announced beta support for buying and selling USDC using CNY payments via Alipay. Alipay also warned users to exercise caution to protect their funds and account security. — link

The Bank of Canada on October 28, 2026, raised its target for the overnight rate by 25 basis points to 2.5%, the first increase since July 2023.
